results.note: require_more_bars_than_talib_lookback (registry.py:76-91) is a pydantic model_validator on IndicatorDefinition itself — it fires for every entry the moment it declares talib_function+parameters, with no per-indicator hardcoded switch. test_lookback.py:38-84 proves this by combining load_registry().root (the real registry) with synthetic new indicators and asserting the check applies uniformly.

RSI(14) lookback asserted ==14 (line 90); RSI(21) with required_bars=15 raises ValidationError matching 'RSI.*lookback 21' (line 91-92), proving the lookback value is computed from the declared parameters via talib.abstract.Function.set_parameters (registry.py:84-85), not a fixed constant.

Constructs BBANDS(timeperiod=20) with required_bars=18 (lookback=19) and asserts pytest.raises(ValidationError, match='BBANDS.*required_bars 18.*lookback 19') — a real constructed failure, not a tautological or assertion-free test.

IndicatorRegistry.require_bar_counts (registry.py:108-121) rejects RECURSIVE_TALIB_FUNCTIONS={RSI,ATR,EMA,STOCHRSI,MACD} entries with required_bars<250, i.e. the published convergence figure (documented in project-documents/11_Data_Model.md's measured warm-up table), stacked on top of (not replacing) the per-parameter mechanical-lookback check. Parametrized test (test_lookback.py:107-132) exercises exactly these 5 functions at required_bars=249 and asserts each raises ValidationError matching '<FUNC>.*at least 250'.
Dedicated gate `uv run python -m ingest.registry --validate` exited 0, which runs load_registry() (registry.py:248-252) over the shipped ingest/registry.yaml.

note: All 5 criteria are backed by concrete, non-tautological evidence: the validation is a generic pydantic model_validator (not a hardcoded per-indicator list), the tests construct real failing cases and assert on the raised messages, and the C5 cmd gate passed. Note the shipped registry.yaml currently has only one entry (btc_daily_close, no talib_function) — actual population with the ~32/RSI/ATR/etc. indicators is deferred to US-407, which is consistent with this story's scope (the mechanism, proven via constructed/synthetic cases) rather than a gap.
